c.v: The data path block pops RAM data and transmits them on sdhost_cdata_out during a write-data transfer, or it receives data on sdhost_cdata_in and pushes them into RAM during a read-data transfer.

The data path loads new data parameters, i.e., expected data, read/write data transfer, stream/block transfer, block size, byte count, card type, timeout registers, etc., whenever a data transfer command is not in progress.
